item.title: WRE News: Miami Beach Named World’s Most Expensive New Year’s Eve Destination
item.description: Miami, FL - December 29, 2025 - According to a new study by Cheaphotels.org, Miami Beach topped a global ranking of the most expensive destinations for New Year’s Eve hotel stays. The survey analyzed the lowest available rates for a three-night stay from December 30 through January 2 at centrally located, three-star-or-higher hotels across 60 major cities worldwide. item.title: WRE News: Panther Coffee Announces Closure of Sunset Harbour Location After 13 Years
item.description: Miami, FL - December 29, 2025 - After 13 years as a Sunset Harbour mainstay, Panther Coffee is being forced to close—not because it failed, but because it couldn’t afford to stay.
